# 🎉 Release v1.0.0

## 🚀 What's New
- ✨ Initial release of Astro Strapi Loader
- 🛠️ TypeScript support with full type definitions

## 📚 Documentation
- 📖 Comprehensive README with usage examples

## 📦 Installation
```bash
yarn add @sensinum/astro-strapi-loader@1.0.0
```
or
```bash
npm install @sensinum/astro-strapi-loader@1.0.0
```
